basis_statement: Upload chunk integrity stays provider-neutral. The governed scaffold verifies chunk digests independently and closes transfer integrity over an ordered chunk-digest manifest rather than depending on one vendor's multipart ETag semantics.

notes: Default posture for browser, mobile, and desktop upload transfer.
Works with deterministic replay because the final checksum depends on ordered chunk digests rather than provider-local multipart state.
Available when a tenant wants a wider digest without changing the resumable transfer protocol.
Uses the same manifest-closing strategy as the SHA-256 profile.
Catalogued for interoperable transport negotiation even when the local runtime does not implement it directly.
Must never be treated as authoritative upload truth unless the runtime can compute and verify it end-to-end.
